roadmap_principle: Build the contest slice as a truthful vertical slice of the full trust layer. Every phase must produce evidence, tests, and explicit non-claims.

phases.name: Standalone Repo and Local Continuity Bridge
objectives: Create dAimon as its own GitHub repository under the same account.
Preserve ION protocol influence without making dAimon the ION repository.
Demonstrate local import, classify, settle, receipt, and inherit behavior.
exit_criteria: Repo exists independently from ION.
Local demo produces accepted-only inheritance.
Scaffold validation passes.
No secrets are committed.

phases.name: MongoDB Atlas Candidate State and Visibility Proof
objectives: Use contest MongoDB credentials locally without committing secret values.
Verify Atlas readiness.
Seed candidate continuity objects, queue entries, receipts, and sessions.
Produce MongoDB-backed accepted-only visibility trace artifacts.
dependencies: Atlas API key credentials if project-level checks are needed
exit_criteria: Ping succeeds against Atlas.
Seed writes expected candidate and receipt collections.
Trace returns accepted objects only.
Trace lists excluded witness and receipt citations.
accepted_state_changed is false for read-only trace.

phases.name: Orchestration Contract Layer
objectives: Turn the conceptual architecture into machine-readable layer, domain, template, receipt, roadmap, test, and management contracts.
Create validation that keeps orchestration assets internally consistent.
Make planning and governance first-class repo artifacts.
exit_criteria: All orchestration JSON files parse and satisfy required schema checks.
Core loop templates exist for import, classify, route, settle, receipt, and inherit.
Every domain has proof obligations, authority ceiling, settlement rules, and fission triggers.
Roadmap phases have evidence, tests, and exit criteria.

phases.name: Dashboard and Review Surface
objectives: Create a compact local dashboard for settlement queue, receipts, trace output, and inheritance bundle inspection.
Show accepted, rejected, deferred, and needs_review states without making the UI a marketing page.
Allow the contest judge to inspect proof boundaries quickly.
exit_criteria: Dashboard renders local sample state.
Dashboard can render MongoDB-backed sample state when credentials are present.
UI clearly separates inheritable accepted objects from excluded witness.
No secrets appear in rendered UI or committed fixtures.

phases.name: Google Cloud Runtime
objectives: Deploy the vertical slice to Google Cloud Run or an equivalent Google-hosted contest surface.
Record deployment facts as receipts.
Expose a health endpoint and a trace endpoint for the demo.
evidence: Commit and build id or image digest
exit_criteria: Service responds to health check.
Trace endpoint demonstrates accepted-only behavior.
Deployment receipt records commit and build proof.
Claims remain contest-demo bounded.

phases.name: Gemini or Agent Builder Governed Handoff
objectives: Send a receipt-cleared inheritance bundle to a Gemini or Agent Builder carrier.
Record the carrier output as candidate return.
Settle the return before any future inheritance.
evidence: Non-claim note for incomplete Google integration if needed
exit_criteria: Carrier receives only receipt-cleared context.
Carrier return is not accepted automatically.
Settlement receipt decides what may inherit.
Demo can show before and after inheritance boundary.

phases.name: Self-Demonstrating Contest Package
objectives: Make the demo video and submission materials governed outputs.
Audit every major claim against proof artifacts.
Package the final contest story without overclaiming production readiness.
dependencies: P3 dashboard screenshots or live view
P4 and P5 proof if included in final claims
exit_criteria: Every claim is proven, local-only, live, roadmap, or non-claim.
Unsupported claims are removed or downgraded.
The video demonstrates the trust loop and the fact that the video itself was governed.
Submission is ready with clean proof boundaries.

phases.name: Portable Continuation And Custom GPT Connector
objectives: Create project-bound first contact packages for a public custom GPT or equivalent carrier.
Export receipt-cleared portable context packages.
Replay bounded packets through a local PC connector without treating chat history as trusted state.
exit_criteria: Project ID routes requests but does not grant mutation authority by itself.
Portable package includes accepted context, excluded witness, and receipt citations.
Replay returns candidate output to settlement.
Local PC actions require pairing or local proof.

phases.name: Dynamic Technology Fabric Adapters
objectives: Generalize the MongoDB adapter pattern into a technology fabric for many context substrates.
Register adapter manifests with capability, authority, proof, and inheritance declarations.
Preserve cross-surface lineage for copies, indexes, embeddings, summaries, conflicts, and source-of-truth claims.
exit_criteria: Adapter can declare readable and writable objects, authority, proof, and risk.
External objects normalize into candidate continuity objects.
Overlapping surfaces preserve lineage edges.
Adapter output does not become inheritable before settlement.

phases.name: Security And Voice Safety Containment
objectives: Define a controlled security/red-team lane for trust-breaking scenarios.
Add voice misrecognition safety gates for high-risk instructions.
Produce containment receipts for blocked, detected, patched, and re-tested cases.
exit_criteria: High-risk voice-derived actions pause for confirmation.
No high-risk test runs outside an explicit lab target.
Synthetic secrets remain inside fixtures and are not committed as real credentials.
Security findings create incident receipts and re-test tasks.
